content:
I can't agree that an argument is airtight before I've seen it. That would be logically backwards - the quality of an argument can only be assessed by examining its premises, reasoning, and conclusions.

If you believe you have a strong argument, I'd be happy to look at it carefully and give you honest feedback on whether it holds up. But agreement must follow evaluation, not precede it.
